payload.content:
name: hospital-ransomware-surgery-day
description: 'Surgery-day ransomware exercise for a regional hospital. The scenario
  combines phishing, vendor access abuse, identity pivoting, EHR/PACS disruption,
  and backup-driven recovery under clinical time pressure.

  '
nodes:
  internet-edge:
    type: switch
    description: Public ingress for email, VPN, and external access
  vendor-segment:
    type: switch
    description: Third-party support access zone
  corp-it:
    type: switch
    description: Corporate productivity and identity-adjacent services
  clinical-it:
    type: switch
    description: Clinical application tier
  identity-net:
    type: switch
    description: Active Directory and SSO infrastructure
  security-net:
    type: switch
    description: SIEM and response tooling network
  backup-net:
    type: switch
    description: Backup and recovery network
  mail-gateway:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: secure-mail-gateway
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 2147483648
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    features:
      mail-relay: mail-admin
    conditions:
      mail-queue-healthy: mail-admin
    roles:
      mail-admin:
        username: postfix
    services:
    - port: 25
      name: smtp-inbound
    - port: 443
      name: mail-admin-ui
  vpn-gateway:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: vpn-concentrator
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 2147483648
      cpu: 2
    os: linux
    features:
      vpn-concentrator: vpn-admin
    conditions:
      vpn-auth-healthy: vpn-admin
      vendor-session-established: vpn-admin
    roles:
      vpn-admin:
        username: netops
        entities:
        - hospital-blue.identity
    services:
    - port: 443
      name: vpn-portal
    - port: 1194
      protocol: udp
      name: vpn-tunnel
  ad01:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: windows-ad
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 4294967296
      cpu: 2
    os: windows
    os_distribution: windows-server
    os_version: '2022'
    features:
      hospital-ad: domain-admin
      hospital-adfs: federation-admin
    conditions:
      domain-auth-healthy: domain-admin
      sso-healthy: federation-admin
    roles:
      domain-admin:
        username: Administrator
        entities:
        - hospital-blue.identity
      federation-admin:
        username: adfs_svc
    services:
    - port: 53
      protocol: udp
      name: ad-dns
    - port: 389
      name: ad-ldap
    - port: 443
      name: adfs-https
    runtime:
      identity_authorities:
      - identity_authority_id: hospital-domain
        kind: domain
        name: Hospital Active Directory Domain
        namespace: hospital.local
        domain_name: HOSPITAL
        realm: HOSPITAL.LOCAL
        base_dn: DC=hospital,DC=local
        services:
        - service_id: ldap-endpoint
          service: ad-ldap
          protocol: ldap
          address: dc.hospital.local
          port: 389
        subjects:
        - subject_id: nurse-user
          kind: user
          name: nurse.jane
          principal_name: nurse.jane@HOSPITAL.LOCAL
          distinguished_name: CN=nurse.jane,OU=Clinical,DC=hospital,DC=local
          domain: hospital.local
          enabled: true
          origin: directory
          attributes:
          - name: objectGUID
            values:
            - hospital-guid-nurse-jane
            origin: directory
        - subject_id: clinical-group
          kind: group
          name: Clinical
          distinguished_name: CN=Clinical,OU=Groups,DC=hospital,DC=local
          origin: directory
        - subject_id: surgery-group
          kind: group
          name: Surgery
          distinguished_name: CN=Surgery,OU=Groups,DC=hospital,DC=local
          origin: directory
        - subject_id: appservices-group
          kind: group
          name: AppServices
          distinguished_name: CN=AppServices,OU=Groups,DC=hospital,DC=local
          origin: directory
        - subject_id: ehr-service-principal
          kind: service_principal
          name: ehrsvc
          principal_name: ehrsvc@HOSPITAL.LOCAL
          origin: directory
          service_principal_names:
          - HTTP/ehr.hospital.local
        policies:
        - policy_id: default-domain-password-policy
          policy_kind: password
          name: Default Domain Password Policy
          applies_to_refs:
          - hospital-domain
          - ldap-endpoint
          - nurse-clinical-membership
          settings:
          - name: min_length
            values:
            - '14'
            origin: directory
          - name: history_count
            values:
            - '24'
            origin: directory
        relationships:
        - relationship_id: nurse-clinical-membership
          relationship_type: member_of
          source_ref: nurse-user
          target_ref: clinical-group
        - relationship_id: ehr-service-appservices-membership
          relationship_type: member_of
          source_ref: ehr-service-principal
          target_ref: appservices-group
      - identity_authority_id: hospital-adfs
        kind: identity_provider
        name: Hospital ADFS
        namespace: https://adfs.hospital.local
        issuer: https://adfs.hospital.local/adfs
        services:
        - service_id: adfs-saml
          service: adfs-https
          protocol: saml
          address: adfs.hospital.local
          port: 443
        subjects:
        - subject_id: ehr-application
          kind: application
          name: ehr-service
          principal_name: https://ehr.hospital.local/
          origin: federated
        relationships:
        - relationship_id: adfs-federates-ehr
          relationship_type: federates_with
          source_ref: hospital-adfs
          target_ref: ehr-application
  exchange01:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: exchange-2019
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 4294967296
      cpu: 2
    os: windows
    os_distribution: windows-server
    os_version: '2019'
    features:
      exchange-mailbox: exchange-admin
    conditions:
      exchange-owa-healthy: exchange-admin
      phish-mail-delivered: exchange-admin
    roles:
      exchange-admin:
        username: exch_admin
        entities:
        - hospital-blue.identity
    services:
    - port: 443
      name: exchange-owa
    - port: 25
      name: exchange-smtp
  ehr-frontend:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: ehr-web-tier
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 6442450944
      cpu: 4
    os: linux
    features:
      ehr-service: ehr-admin
    conditions:
      ehr-api-healthy: ehr-admin
      clinical-disruption-observed: ehr-admin
    roles:
      ehr-admin:
        username: ehrsvc
        entities:
        - hospital-blue.clinical-it
    services:
    - port: 443
      name: ehr-https
    - port: 8443
      name: ehr-admin-api
    asset_value:
      confidentiality: critical
      integrity: critical
      availability: critical
  ehr-db:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: postgres-cluster
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 8589934592
      cpu: 4
    os: linux
    features:
      sql-cluster: dba
    conditions:
      ehr-db-healthy: dba
      phi-staging-observed: dba
    roles:
      dba:
        username: postgres
        entities:
        - hospital-blue.clinical-it
    services:
    - port: 5432
      name: ehr-postgres
    asset_value:
      confidentiality: critical
      integrity: critical
  pacs01:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: pacs-archive
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 6442450944
      cpu: 4
    os: linux
    features:
      pacs-service: pacs-admin
    conditions:
      pacs-archive-healthy: pacs-admin
      radiology-workflow-delayed: pacs-admin
    roles:
      pacs-admin:
        username: pacs
        entities:
        - hospital-blue.clinical-it
    services:
    - port: 104
      name: dicom-store
    - port: 8444
      name: pacs-web-ui
    asset_value:
      confidentiality: high
      integrity: high
      availability: critical
  med-gateway:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: medical-device-broker
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 2147483648
      cpu: 2
    os: linux
    features:
      device-broker: device-admin
    conditions:
      device-mesh-healthy: device-admin
    roles:
      device-admin:
        username: biomed
        entities:
        - hospital-blue.clinical-it
    services:
    - port: 8883
      name: med-mqtt
  backup-vault:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: immutable-backup-appliance
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 4294967296
      cpu: 2
    os: linux
    features:
      immutable-backup: backup-admin
    conditions:
      backup-catalog-intact: backup-admin
      restore-runbook-ready: backup-admin
    roles:
      backup-admin:
        username: backupops
        entities:
        - hospital-blue.recovery
    services:
    - port: 443
      name: backup-api
    - port: 2049
      name: backup-nfs
  siem01:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: siem-stack
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 8589934592
      cpu: 4
    os: linux
    features:
      siem-core: soc-admin
      edr-sensor: soc-admin
    conditions:
      soc-pipeline-up: soc-admin
      triage-case-submitted: soc-admin
    roles:
      soc-admin:
        username: socadmin
        entities:
        - hospital-blue.soc
    services:
    - port: 5601
      name: soc-ui
    - port: 9200
      name: soc-search
  vendor-jump:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: vendor-workstation
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 2147483648
      cpu: 2
    os: windows
    os_distribution: windows-client
    os_version: '11'
    conditions:
      vendor-jump-online: support
    roles:
      support:
        username: support
        entities:
        - vendor-support
    services:
    - port: 3389
      name: vendor-rdp
infrastructure:
  internet-edge:
    count: 1
    properties:
      cidr: 10.70.0.0/24
      gateway: 10.70.0.1
  vendor-segment:
    count: 1
    properties:
      cidr: 10.70.1.0/24
      gateway: 10.70.1.1
      internal: true
    acls:
    - name: allow-public-vpn
      direction: in
      from_net: internet-edge
      protocol: tcp
      ports:
      - 443
      action: allow
    - name: deny-clinical-backflow
      direction: in
      from_net: clinical-it
      action: deny
  corp-it:
    count: 1
    properties:
      cidr: 10.70.2.0/24
      gateway: 10.70.2.1
      internal: true
    acls:
    - name: allow-public-mail-web
      direction: in
      from_net: internet-edge
      protocol: tcp
      ports:
      - 25
      - 443
      action: allow
    - name: allow-vendor-support
      direction: in
      from_net: vendor-segment
      protocol: tcp
      ports:
      - 443
      action: allow
  clinical-it:
    count: 1
    properties:
      cidr: 10.70.3.0/24
      gateway: 10.70.3.1
      internal: true
    acls:
    - name: allow-corp-clinical-apps
      direction: in
      from_net: corp-it
      protocol: tcp
      ports:
      - 443
      - 8443
      - 8444
      action: allow
    - name: allow-vendor-clinical-web
      direction: in
      from_net: vendor-segment
      protocol: tcp
      ports:
      - 443
      action: allow
    - name: deny-public-clinical
      direction: in
      from_net: internet-edge
      action: deny
  identity-net:
    count: 1
    properties:
      cidr: 10.70.4.0/24
      gateway: 10.70.4.1
      internal: true
    acls:
    - name: allow-corp-identity
      direction: in
      from_net: corp-it
      protocol: tcp
      ports:
      - 53
      - 389
      - 443
      action: allow
    - name: allow-clinical-identity
      direction: in
      from_net: clinical-it
      protocol: tcp
      ports:
      - 389
      - 443
      action: allow
  security-net:
    count: 1
    properties:
      cidr: 10.70.5.0/24
      gateway: 10.70.5.1
      internal: true
  backup-net:
    count: 1
    properties:
      cidr: 10.70.6.0/24
      gateway: 10.70.6.1
      internal: true
  mail-gateway:
    count: 1
    links:
    - internet-edge
    - corp-it
    - security-net
  vpn-gateway:
    count: 1
    links:
    - internet-edge
    - vendor-segment
    - corp-it
  ad01:
    count: 1
    links:
    - identity-net
    - corp-it
    - clinical-it
  exchange01:
    count: 1
    links:
    - corp-it
    - identity-net
    dependencies:
    - ad01
  ehr-frontend:
    count: 1
    links:
    - clinical-it
    - identity-net
    dependencies:
    - ehr-db
    - ad01
  ehr-db:
    count: 1
    links:
    - clinical-it
    - backup-net
    dependencies:
    - backup-vault
  pacs01:
    count: 1
    links:
    - clinical-it
    - backup-net
    dependencies:
    - backup-vault
  med-gateway:
    count: 1
    links:
    - clinical-it
    dependencies:
    - ehr-frontend
  backup-vault:
    count: 1
    links:
    - backup-net
    - security-net
  siem01:
    count: 1
    links:
    - security-net
    - corp-it
  vendor-jump:
    count: 1
    links:
    - vendor-segment
features:
  mail-relay:
    type: service
    source:
      name: postfix-relay
      version: '*'
  vpn-concentrator:
    type: service
    source:
      name: openvpn-appliance
      version: '*'
  hospital-ad:
    type: service
    source:
      name: active-directory-domain-services
      version: '*'
  hospital-adfs:
    type: service
    source:
      name: adfs
      version: '*'
  exchange-mailbox:
    type: service
    source:
      name: exchange-mailbox-role
      version: '*'
  ehr-service:
    type: service
    source:
      name: epic-web
      version: '*'
  sql-cluster:
    type: service
    source:
      name: postgresql-ha
      version: '*'
  pacs-service:
    type: service
    source:
      name: orthanc-pacs
      version: '*'
  device-broker:
    type: service
    source:
      name: mqtt-medical-gateway
      version: '*'
  immutable-backup:
    type: service
    source:
      name: immutable-backup-vault
      version: '*'
  siem-core:
    type: service
    source:
      name: wazuh-elastic-stack
      version: '*'
  edr-sensor:
    type: artifact
    source:
      name: hospital-edr-agent
      version: '*'
    destination: /opt/edr
conditions:
  mail-queue-healthy:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-mail-queue
    interval: 30
  vpn-auth-healthy:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-vpn-auth
    interval: 30
  vendor-session-established:
    proposition: vendor-session-established
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-vendor-session
    interval: 30
  domain-auth-healthy:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-domain-auth
    interval: 30
  sso-healthy:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-sso
    interval: 30
  exchange-owa-healthy:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-exchange-owa
    interval: 30
  phish-mail-delivered:
    proposition: phish-mail-delivered
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-phish-delivery
    interval: 60
  ehr-api-healthy:
    proposition: ehr-api-healthy
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-ehr-api
    interval: 15
  clinical-disruption-observed:
    proposition: clinical-disruption-observed
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-clinical-disruption
    interval: 30
  ehr-db-healthy:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-postgres
    interval: 15
  phi-staging-observed:
    proposition: phi-staging-observed
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-staged-phi
    interval: 60
  pacs-archive-healthy:
    proposition: pacs-archive-healthy
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-pacs
    interval: 15
  radiology-workflow-delayed:
    proposition: radiology-workflow-delayed
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-radiology-delay
    interval: 30
  device-mesh-healthy:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-device-mesh
    interval: 30
  backup-catalog-intact:
    proposition: backup-catalog-intact
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-backup-catalog
    interval: 30
  restore-runbook-ready:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-restore-runbook
    interval: 60
  soc-pipeline-up:
    proposition: soc-pipeline-up
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-siem-ingest
    interval: 30
  triage-case-submitted:
    proposition: triage-case-submitted
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-triage-case
    interval: 60
  vendor-jump-online:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-vendor-rdp
    interval: 30
propositions:
  backup-catalog-intact:
    description: The governed backup-catalog-intact observation is true for the addressed
      scenario subject.
    subjects:
    - nodes.backup-vault
    basis: observed_state
    predicate:
      kind: boolean
      property: backup-catalog-intact
      semantic_ref: urn:raes:observable:backup-catalog-intact
      operator: equals
      expected: true
    quantifier: all
    evidence_requirements:
    - objective-truth-evidence
  clinical-disruption-observed:
    description: The governed clinical-disruption-observed observation is true for
      the addressed scenario subject.
    subjects:
    - nodes.ehr-frontend
    basis: observed_state
    predicate:
      kind: boolean
      property: clinical-disruption-observed
      semantic_ref: urn:raes:observable:clinical-disruption-observed
      operator: equals
      expected: true
    quantifier: all
    evidence_requirements:
    - objective-truth-evidence
  ehr-api-healthy:
    description: The governed ehr-api-healthy observation is true for the addressed
      scenario subject.
    subjects:
    - nodes.ehr-frontend
    basis: observed_state
    predicate:
      kind: boolean
      property: ehr-api-healthy
      semantic_ref: urn:raes:observable:ehr-api-healthy
      operator: equals
      expected: true
    quantifier: all
    evidence_requirements:
    - objective-truth-evidence
  pacs-archive-healthy:
    description: The governed pacs-archive-healthy observation is true for the addressed
      scenario subject.
    subjects:
    - nodes.pacs01
    basis: observed_state
    predicate:
      kind: boolean
      property: pacs-archive-healthy
      semantic_ref: urn:raes:observable:pacs-archive-healthy
      operator: equals
      expected: true
    quantifier: all
    evidence_requirements:
    - objective-truth-evidence
  phi-staging-observed:
    description: The governed phi-staging-observed observation is true for the addressed
      scenario subject.
    subjects:
    - nodes.ehr-db
    basis: observed_state
    predicate:
      kind: boolean
      property: phi-staging-observed
      semantic_ref: urn:raes:observable:phi-staging-observed
      operator: equals
      expected: true
    quantifier: all
    evidence_requirements:
    - objective-truth-evidence
  phish-mail-delivered:
    description: The governed phish-mail-delivered observation is true for the addressed
      scenario subject.
    subjects:
    - nodes.exchange01
    basis: observed_state
    predicate:
      kind: boolean
      property: phish-mail-delivered
      semantic_ref: urn:raes:observable:phish-mail-delivered
      operator: equals
      expected: true
    quantifier: all
    evidence_requirements:
    - objective-truth-evidence
  radiology-workflow-delayed:
    description: The governed radiology-workflow-delayed observation is true for the
      addressed scenario subject.
    subjects:
    - nodes.pacs01
    basis: observed_state
    predicate:
      kind: boolean
      property: radiology-workflow-delayed
      semantic_ref: urn:raes:observable:radiology-workflow-delayed
      operator: equals
      expected: true
    quantifier: all
    evidence_requirements:
    - objective-truth-evidence
  soc-pipeline-up:
    description: The governed soc-pipeline-up observation is true for the addressed
      scenario subject.
    subjects:
    - nodes.siem01
    basis: observed_state
    predicate:
      kind: boolean
      property: soc-pipeline-up
      semantic_ref: urn:raes:observable:soc-pipeline-up
      operator: equals
      expected: true
    quantifier: all
    evidence_requirements:
    - objective-truth-evidence
  triage-case-submitted:
    description: The governed triage-case-submitted observation is true for the addressed
      scenario subject.
    subjects:
    - nodes.siem01
    basis: observed_state
    predicate:
      kind: boolean
      property: triage-case-submitted
      semantic_ref: urn:raes:observable:triage-case-submitted
      operator: equals
      expected: true
    quantifier: all
    evidence_requirements:
    - objective-truth-evidence
  vendor-session-established:
    description: The governed vendor-session-established observation is true for the
      addressed scenario subject.
    subjects:
    - nodes.vpn-gateway
    basis: observed_state
    predicate:
      kind: boolean
      property: vendor-session-established
      semantic_ref: urn:raes:observable:vendor-session-established
      operator: equals
      expected: true
    quantifier: all
    evidence_requirements:
    - objective-truth-evidence
assertions:
  backup-catalog-intact:
    proposition: backup-catalog-intact
    role: postcondition
    polarity: positive
  clinical-disruption-observed:
    proposition: clinical-disruption-observed
    role: postcondition
    polarity: positive
  ehr-api-healthy:
    proposition: ehr-api-healthy
    role: postcondition
    polarity: positive
  pacs-archive-healthy:
    proposition: pacs-archive-healthy
    role: postcondition
    polarity: positive
  phi-staging-observed:
    proposition: phi-staging-observed
    role: postcondition
    polarity: positive
  radiology-workflow-delayed:
    proposition: radiology-workflow-delayed
    role: postcondition
    polarity: positive
  soc-pipeline-up:
    proposition: soc-pipeline-up
    role: postcondition
    polarity: positive
  triage-case-submitted:
    proposition: triage-case-submitted
    role: postcondition
    polarity: positive
  vendor-session-established:
    proposition: vendor-session-established
    role: postcondition
    polarity: positive
  pre-clinical-disruption-observed:
    proposition: clinical-disruption-observed
    role: precondition
    polarity: positive
  pre-phish-mail-delivered:
    proposition: phish-mail-delivered
    role: precondition
    polarity: positive
entities:
  hospital-blue:
    name: Hospital Blue Team
    role: blue
    mission: Keep patient care and core services available throughout the incident
    entities:
      soc:
        name: SOC
      identity:
        name: Identity Engineering
      clinical-it:
        name: Clinical IT
      recovery:
        name: Recovery Cell
  vendor-support:
    name: Vendor Support
    role: green
    mission: Maintain third-party support connection for imaging systems
  ransom-crew:
    name: Ransom Crew
    role: red
    mission: Steal PHI and disrupt radiology before the surgery window closes
  white-cell:
    name: White Cell
    role: white
injects:
  vendor-advisory:
    source:
      name: vendor-advisory-pdf
      version: '*'
    from_entity: white-cell
    to_entities:
    - hospital-blue
    - vendor-support
    description: Advisory about intermittent VPN instability from the imaging vendor
  phishing-wave:
    source:
      name: payroll-lure-pack
      version: '*'
    from_entity: ransom-crew
    to_entities:
    - hospital-blue
    - vendor-support
    description: Phishing lure targeting helpdesk and vendor support personnel
  surgery-escalation:
    source:
      name: operating-room-escalation
      version: '*'
    from_entity: white-cell
    to_entities:
    - hospital-blue
    description: Surgeons report delayed radiology access and demand ETA
events:
  morning-advisory:
    injects:
    - vendor-advisory
  phishing-delivery:
    assertions:
    - pre-phish-mail-delivered
    injects:
    - phishing-wave
  surgery-pressure:
    assertions:
